*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:DOCKER - [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A OUTPUT ! -d 127.0.0.0/8 -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A POSTROUTING -s 172.19.0.0/16 ! -o br-8c0be9d57fff -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -s 172.30.0.0/24 ! -o dpcustom -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -s 172.18.0.0/16 ! -o docker0 -j MASQUERADE
-A DOCKER ! -i docker0 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8080 -j DNAT --to-destination 172.18.0.2:80
-A DOCKER -d 127.0.0.1/32 ! -i docker0 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8081 -j DNAT --to-destination 172.18.0.2:80
-A DOCKER ! -i dpcustom -p tcp -m tcp --dport 9090 -j DNAT --to-destination 172.30.0.2:80
-A DOCKER ! -i br-8c0be9d57fff -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -j DNAT --to-destination 172.19.0.2:80
COMMIT
